about: National Botanic Gardens Kilmacurragh (OPW, free). Round 2, garden-first method. Zero verified: the garden's own pages (heritageireland.ie, botanicgardens.ie 403) name no individual tree; the Irish Times 2015-03-07 (Janet Acton) and Travel Extra pieces name champions without girth or position. House ruin ~52.9291,-6.1467. Free entry, open daily except 25 Dec, 9-17 (last admission 16:30), winter 9-16:30 (heritageireland.ie, fetched 2026-11-03); gates may close at capacity; no parking outside the gardens.

leads.name: Wellingtonia, 45 m
leads.source: Irish Times 'Kilmacurragh Arboretum: Ireland's secret garden' (2015) and travelextra.ie: '45m Wellingtonia' among champion trees
leads.reason: No position, girth or register row for it (the 8 Kilmacurragh register rows hold no Sequoiadendron); a dated photo or the Tree Register champion entry would place it. A historical survey of Irish Wellingtonias reportedly lists two at Kilmacurragh (110 ft x 19 ft 3 in) but that came from a search summary only, not seen
